question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public plugin-SDK contract for channel-specific handling of transient tool progress?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but repository policy makes new public plugin API a compatibility-sensitive maintainer decision that tests and live Slack proof cannot settle.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the narrow generic progress intent, document its semantics, and allow Slack and future channels to consume it.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Move the discriminator behind an internal or Slack/Codex-owned boundary and avoid expanding third-party plugin API.

options.title: Use a status-notice subtype
options.body: Extend the existing status-notice model with a typed subtype if maintainers want one unified transient-notice contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic progress intent, document its semantics, and allow Slack and future channels to consume it.
